description: Every Paneflow method, generated from crates/paneflow-api. A test fails when this file and the declarations differ; regenerate it with PANEFLOW_API_SNAPSHOT=write cargo test -p paneflow-api snapshot.

methods.name: system.ping
methods.summary: Check that the endpoint answers.

methods.name: system.capabilities

orchestration.description: True when requests may set a command, a prompt or an env

scripting.description: True when surface.send_text and surface.send_keystroke are open

methods.summary: List the methods this endpoint serves and whether its gates are open.

methods.name: system.identify
methods.summary: Name the running app, its version and its wire protocol.

methods.name: system.counters
methods.summary: Read the app's work counters: renders, git spawns, process spawns.

methods.name: workspace.list
methods.summary: List every workspace with its title, directory, pane count and space.

methods.gate_note: A request that sets a command, a prompt or an env is refused with -32601 unless PANEFLOW_IPC_ORCHESTRATION=1 or PANEFLOW_IPC_SCRIPTING=1.
methods.name: workspace.create

LayoutDocument.description: A layout node as workspace files declare it: {"type": "pane", "surfaces": [...]} or {"type": "split", "direction": "horizontal"|"vertical", "ratios": [...], "children": [...]}

cwd.description: Directory of the first pane; it must exist

space.description: Space by name or id; the active space when absent

methods.summary: Open a workspace with one terminal, or with a layout document.

methods.name: workspace.select
methods.summary: Show the workspace at an index.

methods.name: workspace.close
methods.summary: Close the workspace at an index; the last workspace cannot be closed.

methods.name: workspace.current

LayoutDocument.description: A layout node as workspace files declare it: {"type": "pane", "surfaces": [...]} or {"type": "split", "direction": "horizontal"|"vertical", "ratios": [...], "children": [...]}

methods.summary: Describe the shown workspace with its layout document, or null when none is shown.

methods.gate_note: A request that sets a command, a prompt or an env is refused with -32601 unless PANEFLOW_IPC_ORCHESTRATION=1 or PANEFLOW_IPC_SCRIPTING=1.
methods.name: workspace.restore_layout
methods.summary: Conform the shown tab to a layout document, reusing its panes.

methods.gate_note: A request that sets a command, a prompt or an env is refused with -32601 unless PANEFLOW_IPC_ORCHESTRATION=1 or PANEFLOW_IPC_SCRIPTING=1.
methods.name: workspace.up
methods.summary: Open a workspace from pane specs, each with its own directory, command or prompt.

methods.name: surface.list

scope_session.description: List the workspace that holds this session

workspace_id.description: List this workspace instead of the shown one

methods.summary: List the surfaces of the shown workspace, or of one workspace, with their identity.

methods.name: surface.read

fenced.description: Wrap the text in an untrusted-output fence; the ai_injection_fence setting decides when absent

lines.description: Trailing lines to return, clamped to 1..4000

name.description: Pick the surface by its unique name instead of its id

offset.description: Lines to skip back from the end of the buffer

surface_id.description: The surface to read; the first surface of the shown tab when absent

methods.summary: Read a surface's trailing scrollback lines.

methods.name: surface.search

pattern.description: Substring or pattern to find, at most 512 bytes

methods.summary: Find the scrollback lines of a surface that contain a pattern.

methods.name: surface.rename

name.description: The new name; an absent or empty name clears the custom name

methods.summary: Give a surface a custom name, or clear it.

methods.gate_note: Refused with -32601 unless PANEFLOW_IPC_SCRIPTING=1 or ai_unrestricted is on.
methods.name: surface.send_text

force.description: Write even when the agent waits for a decision; the write is logged

paste.description: Force or refuse bracketed paste; decided from the target when absent

scope_session.description: The calling pane's session; writes stay in its workspace

submit.description: Submit with a carriage return after the text

text.description: Text to write; required unless submit is true. At most 64 KiB

methods.summary: Write text into a surface, submitting it only when asked.

methods.gate_note: Refused with -32601 unless PANEFLOW_IPC_SCRIPTING=1 or ai_unrestricted is on.
methods.name: surface.send_keystroke

keystroke.description: Dash-separated key such as escape, ctrl-c or alt-f; required, and never one that submits a line

methods.summary: Send a named key such as escape or ctrl-c to a surface.

methods.gate_note: A request that sets a command, a prompt or an env is refused with -32601 unless PANEFLOW_IPC_ORCHESTRATION=1 or PANEFLOW_IPC_SCRIPTING=1.
methods.name: surface.split

direction.description: horizontal stacks the panes, vertical puts them side by side

surface_id.description: Split the pane holding this surface; the shown tab's first pane when absent

methods.summary: Split the pane holding a surface and start a terminal in the new pane.

methods.name: surface.focus
methods.summary: Reveal a surface and give it the keyboard focus.

methods.name: surface.status
methods.summary: Read a surface's agent state, hook status and output generation.

methods.name: fleet.list
methods.summary: List the agents running in every workspace.

methods.name: events.subscribe

surfaces.description: Only stream events about these surfaces

types.description: Only stream these event types: surface_changed and the ai.* lifecycle types

methods.summary: Stream surface and agent events as JSON lines: a subscribed frame, then events, heartbeat and dropped frames.

methods.name: tmux.compat

argv.description: The tmux command line, at most 256 arguments and 256 KiB

methods.summary: Run a tmux command for an agent team, as the paneflow tmux shim does.

methods.name: client.list_actions
methods.summary: List the window's built-in actions: the names key bindings and client.dispatch_action accept.

methods.name: client.dispatch_action

name.description: A name from client.list_actions, such as toggle_zoom

methods.summary: Dispatch a built-in action in the window as the command palette does, and reply once it is dispatched.

methods.name: system.describe

callable.description: Whether the endpoint that answered serves the method itself

fallback.description: The process that answers when the owner is not running

owner.description: The process that serves the method: window, worker or host

params.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 of the params object

reply.description: inline, ready, deferred, async or stream

methods.summary: Describe every method, or one: owner, gate, params and result schemas, examples.

methods.name: pane.write

text.description: Text to relay, prefixed with a provenance line

methods.summary: Relay a message from one agent's pane into another's, once a human allows the pair.

methods.name: worker.hello
methods.summary: Open a worker connection and read the worker's identity and capabilities.

methods.name: worker.status
methods.summary: Read the worker's pid, version, session count and counters.

methods.name: worker.shutdown
methods.summary: Ask the worker to stop; terminals keep running in the host.

methods.name: agent.snapshot

sessions.description: One reduced row per session: status, activity, unread, runtime

methods.summary: Read every session's reduced agent row and the usage frame.

methods.name: agent.follow

sessions.description: One reduced row per session: status, activity, unread, runtime

methods.summary: Stream the session projection: a snapshot header, then one frame per reduced transition.

methods.name: agent.activity_log
methods.summary: Read the most recent agent activity entries.

methods.name: agent.acknowledge

session.description: One session, when sessions is absent

methods.summary: Clear the unread mark of sessions and publish the lowered rows.

methods.name: usage.snapshot
methods.summary: Read the usage ledger snapshot.

methods.name: usage.refresh

agent.description: The agent runtime slug, such as claude or codex

config_dir.description: Absolute path of the agent's configuration directory

force.description: usage.import only: start again even when an import already ran

methods.summary: Read fresh usage for the running agents and the listed accounts.

methods.name: usage.import

agent.description: The agent runtime slug, such as claude or codex

config_dir.description: Absolute path of the agent's configuration directory

force.description: usage.import only: start again even when an import already ran

methods.summary: Start importing past activity from the agents' local logs.

methods.name: events.follow

epoch.description: The epoch since belongs to; a different epoch is refused with an evicted error

since.description: Replay the events after this seq first; refused with an evicted error when they left the ring

types.description: Only send these types: exact names or a family such as terminal.*

workspace_id.description: Only send events about this layout workspace id

epoch.description: Names this worker start; a new epoch restarts seq at 1

seq.description: The seq of the last event appended before the stream opened, 0 when none

methods.summary: Stream the worker's numbered event log: a following header, then every event with consecutive seq values, keepalive frames when quiet, and an end frame when the worker closes the stream. A since that left the ring, or an epoch from another worker start, is refused with -32040 and data {reason: evicted, seq, epoch}.

methods.name: events.publish

session.description: The terminal session id the host assigned

type.description: A layout event type: workspace.*, tab.*, pane.*, surface.* or layout.*

events.description: Events in the order their ops were applied

seqs.description: The seq each event received, in order

methods.summary: Append layout events to the worker's log, in order. Any event outside the layout family refuses the whole batch with -32602.

methods.name: config.status

file.description: The file the problem is in, such as init.lua or lua/dev.lua

found.description: Whether the file existed at the last load

handler_errors.description: Errors raised by event handlers of the active configuration

loaded_at_ms.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch when the active configuration loaded

ok.description: False when the last load failed and the previous configuration stayed active

path.description: Absolute path of the init.lua the worker reads

timer_errors.description: Errors raised by timers of the active configuration

methods.summary: Read the state of init.lua: its path, whether it was found, when it loaded, what it declared and its load problems.

methods.name: config.reload

file.description: The file the problem is in, such as init.lua or lua/dev.lua

found.description: Whether the file existed at the last load

handler_errors.description: Errors raised by event handlers of the active configuration

loaded_at_ms.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch when the active configuration loaded

ok.description: False when the last load failed and the previous configuration stayed active

path.description: Absolute path of the init.lua the worker reads

timer_errors.description: Errors raised by timers of the active configuration

methods.summary: Load init.lua again now and return the status; a failed load keeps the previous configuration active.

methods.name: action.list

agents.description: Whether agents may run the action

args.description: JSON Schema of the arguments, an object with one property per argument

source.description: Where the action is declared, such as init.lua:12

methods.summary: List the actions init.lua declared, with their titles, argument schemas and sources.

methods.name: action.invoke

origin.description: What started the run: key, palette, cli, api, script, agent, timer or event; api by default

args.description: The action's arguments, checked against its declared schema

result.description: What run returned; absent when it returned nothing, nil or true

methods.summary: Run an action of init.lua with arguments and return what it returned. Arguments are checked against its schema first; a run is stopped after 30 seconds.

methods.name: keymap.list

key.description: The key as written, in the syntax of paneflow.json shortcuts

target.description: lua for an action of init.lua, builtin for a name the window resolves

unbound.description: Keys init.lua unbound, for the window to drop their defaults

methods.summary: List the key bindings init.lua declared and the keys it unbound, for the window to apply.
